name: SIME
recent: Sime Darby 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日召开第 20 届常年股东大会及特别股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过，包括设立长期激励计划（含员工配股与员工认股计划）及向集团首席执行官 Dato' Jeffri Salim Davidson 的配股。近期多家机构股东（EPF、KWAP、Amanah Saham Bumiputera）连续申报持股变动。最新财报显示 2026 财年营收 167.1 亿令吉，净利 3.22 亿令吉，净利率 1.9%。
notable: 第 20 届常年股东大会所有普通决议案获通过。
特别股东大会通过设立长期激励计划（含员工配股与员工认股计划）及向集团首席执行官配股。
多家机构股东（EPF、KWAP、Amanah Saham Bumiputera）于 10 月底至 11 月初连续申报持股变动。
risks: 净利按季下降 50.8%，按年下降 57.8%，净利率由 4.2% 降至 1.9%。

recent_en: Sime Darby held its 20th AGM and an EGM on 12 November 2026, where all ordinary resolutions were passed, including the establishment of a Long-Term Incentive Plan comprising an Employee Share Grant Scheme and an Employee Share Option Scheme, and the allocation to Group CEO Dato' Jeffri Salim Davidson. Several institutional shareholders (EPF, KWAP, Amanah Saham Bumiputera) filed consecutive changes in shareholding. Latest financials show FY2026 revenue of RM16.71 billion and net income of RM322 million, with a net margin of 1.9%.
notable_en: All ordinary resolutions were passed at the 20th AGM.
The EGM approved the establishment of a Long-Term Incentive Plan (comprising an Employee Share Grant Scheme and an Employee Share Option Scheme) and the allocation to the Group CEO.
Several institutional shareholders (EPF, KWAP, Amanah Saham Bumiputera) filed consecutive changes in shareholding from late October to early November.
risks_en: Net income fell 50.8% QoQ and 57.8% YoY, with net margin declining from 4.2% to 1.9%.
earnings_en: FY2026 revenue was RM16.71 billion, up 6.1% QoQ but down 5.9% YoY; net income was RM322 million, down 50.8% QoQ and 57.8% YoY; net margin was 1.9% versus 4.2% previously.
